# Preparation

## Packages and appearance

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if (!require("pacman")) {
  install.packages("pacman")
  library(pacman)
}
p_load(here, survey, srvyr, rio, tidyverse)

options(rio.import.trust = TRUE)

```

## Load total data set

```{r}
#| label: getdata
#| message: false

ess_ger_total <- import(here("data", "raw", "ess_ger_total.csv"))

ess_class_scheme <- import(here("data", "processed", "ess_class_scheme.rds"))
ess_ger_parties  <- import(here("data", "processed", "ess_ger_parties.rds"))

ess_ger_total <- merge(ess_ger_total, ess_class_scheme, by = c("essround", "idno"))
ess_ger_total <- merge(ess_ger_total, ess_ger_parties,  by = c("essround", "idno"))

```

## Recode variables
```{r}
#| label: recoding

missings_low <- c(6, 7, 8, 9)
fix_na_low <- function(x) {
  if_else(x %in% missings_low, NA, x)
}

missings_high <- c(77, 88, 99)
fix_na_high <- function(x) {
  if_else(x %in% missings_high, NA, x)
}

essger <- ess_ger_total %>%
  mutate(
    year = case_when(
      essround == 1 ~ 2002,
      essround == 2 ~ 2004,
      essround == 3 ~ 2006,
      essround == 4 ~ 2008,
      essround == 5 ~ 2010,
      essround == 6 ~ 2012,
      essround == 7 ~ 2014,
      essround == 8 ~ 2016,
      essround == 9 ~ 2018,
      essround == 10 ~ 2020,
      essround == 11 ~ 2022
    ),
    btw = case_when(
      essround == 1 | essround == 2 ~ 2002,
      essround == 3 | essround == 4 ~ 2005,
      essround == 5 | essround == 6 ~ 2009,
      essround == 7 | essround == 8 ~ 2013,
      essround == 9 | essround == 10 ~ 2017,
      essround == 11 ~ 2021
    ),
    age = ifelse(agea < 999, agea, NA),
    age_grp = case_when(
      agea >= 17 & agea <= 29 ~ "18-29",
      agea >= 30 & agea <= 65 ~ "30-65",
      agea >= 66 ~ "66+"
    ),
    cohort = case_when(
      yrbrn <= 1925 ~ "interwar",
      yrbrn >= 1926 & yrbrn <= 1945 ~ "postwar",
      yrbrn >= 1946 & yrbrn <= 1957 ~ "60-70s",
      yrbrn >= 1958 & yrbrn <= 1968 ~ "80s",
      yrbrn >= 1969 & yrbrn <= 1979 ~ "90s",
      yrbrn >= 1980 & yrbrn <= 2009 ~ "millennial"
    ),
    cohort = factor(
      cohort,
      levels = c(
        "interwar", "postwar",
        "60-70s", "80s", "90s", "millennial"
      )
    ),
    gender = case_when(
      gndr == 1 ~ "male",
      gndr == 2 ~ "female"
    ),
    edua = case_when(
      edulvla == 1 | edulvla == 2 ~ "(below) lower secondary",
      edulvla == 3 | edulvla == 4 ~ "upper secondary",
      edulvla == 5 ~ "tertiary"
    ),
    edub = case_when(
      edulvlb < 230 ~ "(below) lower secondary",
      edulvlb > 299 & edulvlb < 424 ~ "upper secondary",
      edulvlb > 499 & edulvlb < 801 ~ "tertiary"
    ),
    education = ifelse(is.na(edua), edub, edua),
    education = factor(
      education,
      levels = c(
        "(below) lower secondary",
        "upper secondary",
        "tertiary"
      )
    ),
    edu_cat = case_when(
      education == "(below) lower secondary" ~ "low",
      education == "upper secondary" ~ "medium",
      education == "tertiary" ~ "high"
    ),
    edu_cat = factor(
      edu_cat,
      levels = c(
        "low", "medium", "high"
      )
    ),
    height = ifelse(height < 777, height, NA),
    immigrant = case_when(
      brncntr == 1 & facntr == 1 & mocntr == 1 ~ 0,
      brncntr == 2 | facntr == 2 | mocntr == 2 ~ 1
    ),
    att_immigrants = 11-imwbcnt,
    union = case_when(
      mbtru == 1 ~ 1,
      mbtru == 2 | mbtru == 3 ~ 0
    ),
    lrscale = ifelse(lrscale >10, NA, lrscale),
    pid = case_when(
      clsprty == 1 ~ 1,
      clsprty == 2 ~ 0
    ),
    cut_work = 6 - wmcpwrk,
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(
    freehms, wmcpwrk, polintr, cptppola, psppsgva, psppipla,
    badge, sgnptit, pbldmna, bctprd, pstplonl, contplt,
    volunfp), fix_na_low)) %>%
  mutate(freehms = 6 - freehms) %>%
  mutate(across(c(imueclt, gvcldcr, cldcrsv, euftf,
                  trstplt, trstprt, trstprt, stfdem, att_immigrants), fix_na_high),
    inteff = cptppola,
    exteff = 6-psppipla,
    polint = 5 - polintr,
    voted = case_when(
      vote == 1 ~ 1,
      vote == 2 ~ 0
    ),
    class5fac = factor(
      class5fac,
      levels = c(
        "Low-skilled workers",
        "Skilled workers",
        "Small business",
        "Lower-grade service class",
        "Higher-grade service class"
      )
    ),
    across(c(badge, sgnptit, pbldmna, bctprd, pstplonl, volunfp, contplt), 
           ~ if_else(. == 1, 1, 0)
           )
    )

essger <- essger %>%
  dplyr::select(
    idno, essround, year, btw, voted, pvote, pvote_non_voter,
    age, yrbrn, cohort, age_grp, gender, education, edu_cat,
    starts_with("class"), height, immigrant, union, psppipla, psppsgva, att_immigrants,
    lrscale, polint, pid, inteff,  exteff, trstplt, trstprt, trstprl, stfdem,
    badge, sgnptit, pbldmna, bctprd, pstplonl, contplt, volunfp, pspwght) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(pvote_non_voter), !is.na(pspwght)) %>% 
  mutate(pvote_non_voter = factor(pvote_non_voter),
         btw_str = as.character(btw))

# Create weight to adust pvote to actual votes (including nonvoters!)

# Define actual vote shares for each election year
actual_shares <- list(
  `2002` = data.frame(pvote_non_voter = c("christian democrats", "greens", "liberals", "nonvoter", "radical left", "radical right", "social democrats"), 
                      Freq = c(0.314, 0.0701, 0.0603, 0.209, 0.0326, 0.0, 0.314)),
  `2005` = data.frame(pvote_non_voter = c("christian democrats", "greens", "liberals", "nonvoter", "radical left", "radical right", "social democrats"), 
                      Freq = c(0.2849, 0.0656, 0.0793, 0.223, 0.0704, 0.0, 0.2768)),
  `2009` = data.frame(pvote_non_voter = c("christian democrats", "greens", "liberals", "nonvoter", "radical left", "radical right", "social democrats"), 
                      Freq = c(0.257, 0.0814, 0.111, 0.292, 0.0837, 0.0, 0.1749)),
  `2013` = data.frame(pvote_non_voter = c("christian democrats", "greens", "liberals", "nonvoter", "radical left", "radical right", "social democrats"), 
                      Freq = c(0.3167, 0.0641, 0.0366, 0.285, 0.0656, 0.0359, 0.1961)),
  `2017` = data.frame(pvote_non_voter = c("christian democrats", "greens", "liberals", "nonvoter", "radical left", "radical right", "social democrats"), 
                      Freq = c(0.2644, 0.0715, 0.086, 0.238, 0.0739, 0.1013, 0.1648)),
  `2021` = data.frame(pvote_non_voter = c("christian democrats", "greens", "liberals", "nonvoter", "radical left", "radical right", "social democrats"), 
                      Freq = c(0.203, 0.1233, 0.0956, 0.234, 0.0411, 0.0873, 0.2156))  
  )

rake_by_year <- function(subset_data) {
  btw_str <- as.character(unique(subset_data$btw))
  
  if (!btw_str %in% names(actual_shares)) {
    stop(paste("Error: No vote shares found for year", btw_str))
  }
  
  actual_shares_filtered <- actual_shares[[btw_str]]
  
  # Ensure only matched categories are used
  subset_data <- subset_data[subset_data$pvote_non_voter %in% actual_shares_filtered$pvote_non_voter, ]
  actual_shares_filtered <- actual_shares_filtered[actual_shares_filtered$pvote_non_voter %in% subset_data$pvote_non_voter, ]
  
  # Check for missing strata
  sample_levels <- unique(subset_data$pvote_non_voter)
  population_levels <- unique(actual_shares_filtered$pvote_non_voter)
  missing_levels <- setdiff(sample_levels, population_levels)

  if (length(missing_levels) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Error: The following levels are in the sample but missing from actual_shares:", 
               paste(missing_levels, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Ensure population data is not empty
  if (nrow(actual_shares_filtered) == 0) {
    stop(paste("Error: No matching population data for year", btw_str))
  }

  # Ensure factors have the same levels
  all_levels <- unique(unlist(lapply(actual_shares, function(x) x$pvote_non_voter)))
  subset_data$pvote_non_voter <- factor(subset_data$pvote_non_voter, levels = all_levels)
  actual_shares_filtered$pvote_non_voter <- factor(actual_shares_filtered$pvote_non_voter, levels = all_levels)

  design <- svydesign(ids = ~1, weights = ~pspwght, data = subset_data)
  
  design_raked <- rake(
    design,
    sample.margins = list(~pvote_non_voter),
    population.margins = list(actual_shares_filtered)
  )
  
  subset_data$vote_weight <- weights(design_raked)
  return(subset_data)
}

essger <- essger %>% group_split(btw) %>% lapply(rake_by_year) %>% bind_rows()

essger11 <- essger %>% filter(essround == 11)
saveRDS(essger11, here("data", "essger11.rds"))

# Define the survey design
essger_weighted <- essger %>% as_survey_design(strata = essround, weights = vote_weight)

# survey weighted mean ov voted
test1 <- essger_weighted %>% summarise(survey_mean(voted, na.rm = TRUE))
weighted.mean(essger$voted, essger$vote_weight, na.rm = TRUE)

saveRDS(essger, here("data", "processed", "essger.rds"))
saveRDS(essger_weighted, here("data", "processed", "essger_weighted.rds"))

```
